set.body: Implement C1.2a/b static graph: staged reads, settled atomic publication, scoped refusal, observable-boundary poisoning, committed snapshots, per-cell revisions and queued follow-on effects. Validate ordered observations/effect counts against independent reference on JVM/Native. Dynamic topology, full scopes/commands/channels and full Stage 1 exit remain later gates.
set.title: C1 first executable headless transaction/signal slice and independent reference checks
